note: 英会話島。4つの家＝4つの場面で、ウーピーと英語で話す。島の座標はクライアントとサーバーの共有データ：クライアントはここから島を建て、サーバーは同じ座標で「その家の中にいるか」を判定する。会話そのものはサーバーの AI（server/src/ai/tutor.js）が返し、できたこと（aims）の判定もサーバーがする。キャラクターの動画は client/dist/assets/character/（idle.mp4 / talking.mp4）。

spots.name: であいのカフェ
spots.ja: はじめまして の れんしゅう

topics.title: はじめまして
topics.situation: You are behind the counter of a small sunny café on 英会話島, meeting a child for the first time. You are curious about them and easy to talk to.
topics.opening: Hello! Nice to meet you. What is your name?

goals.ja: 名前を つたえる
goals.en: The child says their name.

goals.ja: 元気か 答える
goals.en: The child answers how they are.

goals.ja: すきな ものを 言う
goals.en: The child says something they like.

topics.title: カフェで たのむ
topics.situation: You are the café's owl barista on 英会話島. You have juice, milk, tea and cake. A child has come to the counter.
topics.opening: Welcome! What would you like to drink?

goals.ja: のみものを たのむ
goals.en: The child orders a drink.

goals.ja: いくつ・どれくらい 言う
goals.en: The child says how many, or what size.

goals.ja: お礼を 言う
goals.en: The child says thank you.

spots.name: おかいものストリート
spots.ja: かいもの の れんしゅう

topics.title: おみせで かう
topics.place: おかいものストリート
topics.situation: You are an owl shopkeeper on 英会話島 selling caps, T-shirts, notebooks and pencils. Everything costs between one and ten coins.

goals.ja: ほしい ものを 言う
goals.en: The child says what they want.

goals.ja: ねだんを たずねる
goals.en: The child asks how much it costs.

goals.ja: かうと つたえる
goals.en: The child says they will take it.

topics.title: みちを きく
topics.place: おかいものストリート
topics.situation: You are an owl standing on a street corner of 英会話島. There is a park to the left, a station straight ahead and a library next to the café.
topics.opening: Hi! You look lost. Where do you want to go?

goals.ja: 行きたい 場所を 言う
goals.en: The child says where they want to go.

goals.ja: 道を たずねる
goals.en: The child asks how to get there.

goals.ja: わかったと 返す
goals.en: The child shows they understood, or asks again.

hints: I want to go to the park.

spots.name: がっこうテラス
spots.ja: がっこう の 話

topics.title: 学校の一日
topics.situation: You are an owl teacher sitting on a school terrace on 英会話島, chatting with a child about school. You ask about subjects, lunch and clubs.

goals.ja: すきな 教科を 言う
goals.en: The child names a subject they like.

goals.ja: りゆうを 言う
goals.en: The child gives a reason, using because or a short sentence.

goals.ja: ウーピーに 質問する
goals.en: The child asks a question back.

topics.title: しゅうまつの こと
topics.situation: You are an owl friend on 英会話島 asking a child about their weekend. Past tense is the point: went, played, ate, watched.
topics.opening: Hello! What did you do last weekend?

goals.ja: したことを 過去形で 言う
goals.en: The child says what they did, in the past tense.

goals.ja: だれと・どこで を 言う
goals.en: The child says who they were with, or where.

goals.ja: どうだったか 言う
goals.en: The child says how it was.

spots.name: ゆめのとうだい
spots.ja: しょうらい の 話

topics.title: しょうらいの ゆめ
topics.situation: You are an owl keeper at the top of a lighthouse on 英会話島, talking with a child about the future. You are warm and take their dream seriously.
topics.opening: Good evening! What do you want to be in the future?

goals.ja: なりたい ものを 言う
goals.en: The child says what they want to be or do.

goals.ja: りゆうを 説明する
goals.en: The child explains why, in a sentence or two.

goals.ja: そのために する ことを 言う
goals.en: The child says something they will do to get there.

hints: I want to be a doctor.
Because I want to help people.

topics.title: 行ってみたい 国
topics.en: A country I want to visit
topics.situation: You are an owl keeper who has flown over many countries, talking with a child about travel on 英会話島.
topics.opening: Hello! If you could go anywhere, where would you go?

goals.ja: 行きたい 国を 言う
goals.en: The child names a country or place they want to visit.

goals.ja: そこで したい ことを 言う
goals.en: The child says what they want to do there.

goals.ja: いつ・だれと を 言う
goals.en: The child says when they would go, or who with.

hints: I will go with my family.
